regime: Relief bounce after a broad risk-off week: metals and tech futures rebounding while yields climb on Fed hike bets
takeaway: Gold is up about 2.3% to near $3,618 and silver about 2.8% before the US open, and Nasdaq-100 futures are up about 3% after Friday's tech-led rout. Yields are rising again, with the 2-year up about 7 bp and markets pricing about a 96% chance of a December Fed hike, which matches the Fed-hike pattern; gold is still about 9% below a month ago, so the short-term downtrend check still applies. ETF prices shown are Friday closes until the US open.
